deviations: Question raised (ASM-015, part 1): TC-028-002 expected 15 columns on etl_daily_count_cell_contacts, but MOD-026's table has 9 and DES-001 gives 12 after MOD-028. The table was built with the design's 12 columns. The Product Owner's answer (ASM-015, not yet reviewed) had the Tester change the expected count to 12. The amended suite passes.

Question raised (ASM-015, part 2): TC-028-010 expected event_lapse_count 1 for Y7, who had no CY2025 paid-in. Under the unchanged Phase 1 lapse rule (usp_load_silv_daily_count steps e1 to e3) the count is 0. The rule was not changed. The Product Owner's answer (ASM-015, not yet reviewed) had the Tester add a CY2025 Renewal and payment for Y7 and keep the expected 1 (AC-026-06). The amended suite passes.
notes:
MIG-0030 runs after MIG-0029. It creates no schema. Change scripts add payment_method_id, payer_type_id and concession_type_id (int not null; existing rows get -2) to silv_daily_count_detail, etl_daily_count_cell_contacts, silv_daily_count_adjustment and fact_daily_member_count_detail. The fact's unique clustered index widens to eight columns; id stays bigint and no foreign keys are added. The migration also adds etl_daily_count_applied_attribute, empties the other snapshot tables and writes the 'detail_grain_restatement' marker. usp_load_silv_daily_count puts each contact-day in the cell of its attributes for that day's Campaign Year: no attributes row gives 0, pre-2022 gives -2. It treats the attributes as an input, so an attribute change alone makes a changed contact. While the marker exists it restates at the old grain and writes no adjustment rows. A duplicated attributes row (contact_no, campaign_year) fails the run with 2627 and writes nothing. usp_load_fact_daily_member_count_detail syncs cell by cell on the eight-column key. The detail as-known-at function and the review view carry the three ids. The existing MOD-021 grant on the review view still applies, so no new grant script was written. Dev tests cover: an attribute change in a year with no loaded day (contact recomputed, no adjustment, snapshot updated); the duplicate-row error path; gold summing regions within a segment cell; as-known-at returning a removed segment cell; and the review view's segment ids. Run order is unchanged: MOD-029 moves the daily count after the segment loads.

Test-first: the first run had 26 of 26 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 26 of 26 and 5 unit test(s), in 1 run(s).
